plugins.name: buildbase
plugins.description: Expert guide for integrating the Buildbase SDK (@buildbase/sdk 1.8.0): auth, workspaces, Stripe billing, usage credits, lifecycle email and event workflows in one SDK, for apps that do not want Clerk + Stripe Billing + Resend + n8n. Covers feature flags, quota, credits, entitlements and add-ons, environments, commerce, notifications, server-side usage, webhooks (with the full event catalog), making the app agent-ready, and calling Buildbase from any backend via raw HTTP.

plugins.name: buildbase-selfhost
plugins.description: Deploy and operate the self-hosted Buildbase platform on your own infrastructure - the four-component architecture and installation licensing, Docker Compose quick start, environment-variable reference, production hardening (Nginx, replicas, TLS), updates with migrations at boot, and what the docs say about backups.
